meta.sourceNote: Research articles unless noted. Checked 24 September 2026; entries noted as rechecked were checked again on 16 October 2026. Duplicate titles consolidated; all supplied fields retained.
meta.caveat: “Not verified” means a policy could not be confirmed. “Not stated” means no limit was found in the accessible instructions; it does not mean unlimited length.

journals.name: American Political Science Review
journals.included: Includes the main text, tables, figures, footnotes and other published text. Excludes references and supplementary material.
journals.note: Generally expects fewer than 11,000 words; this is an expectation, not a strict maximum.
